lines.speaker: Mehta
lines.text: Good morning. Please sit down. What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Good morning. My back tooth has been hurting for a week, especially with cold water.

lines.speaker: Mehta
lines.text: I can see it. It needs a filling. I can do it next Tuesday at three in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Tuesday at three works for me. Do I need to stop eating before that?

lines.speaker: Mehta
lines.text: No, just brush well. I will send you the booking confirmation today.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Thank you. I will pay the deposit at the front desk on my way out.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: Hello, this is Mister Brennan, calling about your lease.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Hi Mister Brennan. Thanks for calling. What are the new terms?

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: The rent will increase by three percent from January, and the lease runs for one more year.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Three percent is fair. I will think about it and send you my answer by next Friday.

lines.speaker: Brennan
lines.text: That is fine. Also, a plumber will come next week to look at the bathroom ceiling.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Good. I will make sure someone is home.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: We need to pick a vendor for the payment service. Ravi, what did you find?

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: The second vendor has fixed pricing and better support. The first one is cheaper, but its fees change every month.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Fixed pricing is what we need. I think we should go with the second vendor.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Agreed. We decided to go with the second vendor, and Ravi will send the contract by Friday.

lines.speaker: Ravi
lines.text: I will send the contract by Friday morning and set up the kickoff call.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: I will review the pricing sheet tonight and share my notes tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Have you thought about the Lisbon trip? I am planning the second week of March.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Yes, I would love to go. Which hotel are you thinking of?

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: A small place near the Alma district. I will send you the link tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Great. I will book the flights this weekend once you confirm the dates.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Perfect. We should also work out who will drive from the airport.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: I can drive. I will rent a small car.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Hey Echo, what did Mister Brennan say about the rent?

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: Priya, this is off the record, so please keep it between the two of us.

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: I am planning a surprise party for Maya. The cake is chocolate and the venue is the rooftop terrace.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: She will love it, I am sure of that. Okay, we are back on the record now.

lines.speaker: Levin
lines.text: I will lock the back door before bed tonight, and switch off all the lights.
